intro.title: When a document gets paid
intro.body: What is configured here is not how long the wait is, but the cut-off. A document Finance receives before a cut-off joins that cut-off's payment batch. The date is frozen the moment the document is marked as received and then sent to the requester — changing a schedule here does not move documents already in flight.
intro.holidayNotice: Public holidays are not taken into account yet. If a date falls on a holiday, Finance handles it outside the system.
